notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Forest and a basic Plains.
description:
Activate a basic Plains and a basic Forest you control by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Cast Kytheon by paying {W}.
Kytheon enters the battlefield, triggering Jedit Ojanen and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Jedit Ojanen trigger, causing you to pay {G} to create a 2/2 Cat Warrior creature token.
The Cat Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft twice by tapping the Cat Warrior token and Kytheon, untapping a basic Forest and a basic Plains.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Kytheon from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Kytheon, Hero of Akros // Gideon, Battle-Forged
